evidence.excerpt: We introduce MotionBlind, a contrastive benchmark of self-recorded video for physically grounded motion(speed, magnitude, and direction), the variables a world model must predict.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Each clip carries two complementary yes/no questions, giving four items per instance, and a model earns credit only if all four are correct.
